title: What Happens When Your Muscles Get Sore Days Later?
sources: Cleveland Clinic, 'Delayed Onset Muscle Soreness (DOMS)'. 'Muscle pain sets in one to three days after intense exercise' (line 2); 'When you exercise, you can sometimes cause tiny tears in those fibers' (line 4); 'DOMS builds over several hours' (line 5); 'DOMS usually happens after you try a new activity, kind of training or a workout that's more intense than you're used to' (line 7); 'Some movements are more likely to lead to DOMS': squeezing a muscle while lengthening it, e.g. 'The lowering phase of a bicep curl', 'Walking or running downhill', 'Lunges' (answer, line 8; guess options lifting vs lowering); see a provider if pain lasts more than a week, or if 'Your pee is unusually dark or has blood in it'; 'Go to the emergency room' for rhabdomyolysis symptoms (line 9): https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/symptoms/delayed-onset-muscle-soreness

Houston Methodist (Corbin Hedt, physical therapist), 'Is Lactic Acid Buildup Really What Causes Muscle Soreness After a Workout?' (2021-10-19). Soreness 'isn't from lactic acid buildup at all'; lactic acid is 'generally all' gone 'within about an hour afterwards' (line 3); 'tiny microtears, which trigger inflammatory responses' (line 5); 'you don't actually feel sore until about 24 to 72 hours after your workout': https://www.houstonmethodist.org/blog/articles/2021/oct/is-lactic-acid-buildup-really-what-causes-muscle-soreness-after-a-workout/

Tease (next video): Scientific American, 'Why does my voice sound different?' (2009-01-13), Timothy E. Hullar, otolaryngologist, Washington University School of Medicine: your voice reaches your inner ear through air and through your head's tissues; 'the mechanical properties of your head enhance its deeper, lower-frequency vibrations'; a recording gives 'only the air-conducted component': https://www.scientificamerican.com/article/why-does-my-voice-sound-different/

lines.text: What happens when your muscles get sore days later?
It hits one to three days in. Blame lifting, or lowering?
Forget lactic acid. It's gone in about an hour.
The real culprit? Tiny tears in your muscle fibers.
Ever needed the handrail after leg day?
But here's the twist: the tears get inflamed, and the ache builds for hours.
lines.caps: BUT *HERE'S | THE *TWIST | THE *TEARS | GET *INFLAMED | AND THE *ACHE | *BUILDS | FOR *HOURS

lines.text: It's usually a new workout, or a harder one.
lines.caps: IT'S *USUALLY | A *NEW WORKOUT | OR A *HARDER ONE

lines.text: Answer: lowering. Lunges and downhill runs too.
Dark pee, or sore past a week? Get help fast.
